dev.title: Dev Control Panel
fate.binh_lang.name: Gentle Life
fate.binh_lang.desc: Lower mortality, disease, and disaster risks — ideal for a relaxed family story.

fate.doi_thuc.desc: Historical balance of mortality, harvests, and life hardships.

play_mode.dynasty.desc: When your character dies, choose an heir among children or relatives to carry on the family legacy across generations.
